Women's War.description: This plague signifies the mock grave side of in memory of the 1929 women war. The events in Nigeria in 1929 are often referred to by colonial historians as the Aba Women's riots, though it would be more fitting to label them the Aba Women's rebellion. It was triggered by the enforcement of direct taxation, the establishment of new local courts, and the appointment of warrant chiefs.
